wsWaitingForUpload: Waiting for patient app to upload snapshot… checking every few seconds
wsStillWaiting: Still waiting — ensure the patient app is open (or pull down to refresh on the phone), then tap Refresh snapshot again
wsErrNoSnapshot: No snapshot yet. Tap Refresh snapshot — patient phone uploads when they open the app.
wsFoodNoteClinic: Patient food log from snapshot — read-only. Click a meal for item detail.
wsFoodNoteSelf: Your food log from your last snapshot — read-only.
wsNoItemBreakdown: No item breakdown in snapshot (totals only).
wsProfileNoteClinic: From the patient's last snapshot — read-only.
wsProfileNoteSelf: Your profile, targets, and mentor context from your last snapshot — read-only.
wsChatPrivacyNote: Your private chat about this case, using the shared snapshot. The patient's own coach conversations are not shared with the clinic.
wsChatEmpty: No messages yet — ask about meals, glucose, or goals.
wsRulesIntro: Live rules — edits save to the server and sync to the patient's phone when they open the app.
wsRulesPlaceholder: e.g. Low cholesterol, carbs at least 130g, avoid red meat…
wsRulesSaved: Saved — patient will receive on next app open
wsRulesUnreachable: Could not reach the server. Hard-refresh the page (Ctrl+Shift+R) and try again.
wsRulesHintSnapshotOnly: Showing rules from the patient snapshot. Save to push clinic edits to their phone.
wsRulesHintClinicOnly: Showing clinic rules (no rules in this snapshot). Save syncs to the patient phone.
wsRulesHintMatch: Clinic and snapshot rules match. Save updates the patient phone.
wsRulesHintPhoneNewer: Showing newer rules from the patient phone (snapshot). Save to adopt/edit as clinic rules.
wsRulesHintClinicNewer: Showing clinic rules (newer than the phone snapshot). Snapshot rules are overridden until the patient edits again.
wsRulesNoPriorVersionsHint: No prior versions yet — history appears after a second save with different text.
wsRulesRestoreConfirm: Restore this version as the patient's live rules? Current rules will be archived to history.
wsNutritionNoteClinic: Nutritionist session reports from the patient snapshot — read-only. The Active report is what mentors use (overrides dietary rules on conflict). Use Refresh snapshot after the patient imports a new PDF.
wsNutritionNoteSelf: Nutritionist session reports from your snapshot — read-only. The Active report is what mentors use (overrides dietary rules on conflict). Open the app after importing a new PDF to send an updated snapshot.
wsNutritionEmpty: No nutrition reports in this snapshot.
wsLabsEmpty: No lab reports in this snapshot.
wsLipidsNoteClinic: Lipid trends from lab reports in snapshot{draws}. Use Refresh snapshot on the portal header to load the latest patient upload.
wsLipidsNoteSelf: Lipid trends from lab reports in snapshot{draws}. Import a new lab PDF in the app to update this.
wsLipidNeedMore: Need at least 2 lipid lab draws in the snapshot to show trend charts.
wsTrendEmpty: Need more body trend days in snapshot
wsLipidDisclaimer: General adult targets — not medical advice
wsLipidEmptyNeedTwo: Need at least 2 lipid lab draws in snapshot to show trends
wsLipidEmptyNoSeries: No lipid series with 2+ values in snapshot
